statement: For the self-similar measure mu and Fourier transform F fixed in source.md and problem.md, F(xi) is nonzero for every real xi satisfying 27/25 <= |xi| <= 1024. This is a strict subsidiary theorem and does not settle the frozen assertion for 1024 < |xi| <= 10^7.
contribution: A gap-free exact-rational adaptive Taylor certificate with directed Arb rounding proves a new finite zero-free range almost three orders of magnitude beyond the source's rigorous radius 1.08. Every one of its 11,224 accepted leaves is structurally checked and recomputed at higher precision and recursion depth by a separately implemented coefficient recurrence; the original problem remains unresolved.
